description: Onboarding Wizard produces a valid ConfigurationProfile on completion that passes all validation checks without critical findings
property: For any completed wizard flow, the resulting ConfigurationProfile SHALL pass all Configuration_Validation_Engine checks without findings of severity 'critical'

invariants.description: The produced ConfigurationProfile must pass validate_configuration_profile() without errors
Running diagnostics on the produced profile must yield zero critical findings
The profile must have a valid hardware_class, applied_at timestamp, and at least one credential or model
